title: Ripasso: un weekend alle Cinque Terre
summary: Week 5 review: passato prossimo with avere/essere, agreement, irregular participles — plus Giulia's Cinque Terre trip

blocks.title: Ripasso: la settimana del passato
blocks.body: This week: **avere** + participle (-ato/-uto/-ito), **essere** + participle with **agreement** for motion and reflexives, the most common **irregular** participles (*fatto, visto, preso…*), and how to pick the right auxiliary. Plus the train, the platform, and *timbrare*.
blocks.callout: All of it comes together in Giulia's story below.

blocks.title: Avere or essere? The quick recap

pairs.left: *Ho mangiato, ho visto, ho letto* — avere, transitive verbs
pairs.right: *Sono andata, mi sono svegliato* — essere, motion and reflexives (with agreement)
pairs.note: Not sure? Ask: is there a direct object, or is the subject itself moving/changing?

blocks.explain: *Partire* is a motion verb: always essere, with agreement (*sono partito/a*).

blocks.prompt: Complete: Sofia ___ al mare con le amiche. (andare, passato prossimo)
blocks.explain: *È andata* — Sofia is a woman, so the participle agrees: -a.

blocks.scene: At the bar, Giulia tells Marco and Sofia about her weekend in the Cinque Terre

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Allora, sono andata alle Cinque Terre con Elena!
lines.en: So, I went to the Cinque Terre with Elena!
lines.spotlight: sono andata — feminine agreement, Giulia is talking about herself.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Abbiamo preso il regionale da Bologna, poi il trenino tra i paesi.
lines.en: We took the regional train from Bologna, then the little train between the villages.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Sì, abbiamo fatto il sentiero da Monterosso a Vernazza. Bellissimo.
lines.en: Yes, we did the trail from Monterosso to Vernazza. Beautiful.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: And you ate well, I imagine.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Benissimo! Ho anche visto un tramonto pazzesco sul mare.
lines.en: Great! I also saw an amazing sunset over the sea.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Che invidia! Io sono rimasta qui tutto il weekend.
lines.en: So jealous! I stayed here all weekend.
lines.spotlight: sono rimasta — rimanere is irregular (rimasto) and takes essere.

questions.q: Where did Giulia go this weekend?
How did Giulia and Elena get there?
What did Sofia do this weekend?
options: She went to the Cinque Terre too

blocks.prompt: Have you ever taken a trip like Giulia's? Write 2-3 sentences about your last weekend, using the passato prossimo.
